summary: ci-local stops a stopped run's lane without a sed per process: it reads /proc in the shell, freezes each process of the lane's tree as it finds it, and reads again until no new one appears, so a stopped run on a loaded host exits in well under a second instead of over 20 s, and a worker a stage starts while it is being stopped is stopped too
